change.purpose: Operator request 2026-10-07 after v1.9.1: 'lägga dem i samma valv' (the Drift settings that were still bound to the extension id).

before.driftSettings: In 1.9.1 only the run requirements were vaulted. The 8 Drift settings (Paus mellan analys och post, Max parallella Greenfield and Grundparametrar för uppdragskö: quantum, blocked cooldown, switch delay, hard reload, settle, warm resume) lived only in eic.gf.operator.settings.v1 in chrome.storage.local, bound to the extension id, so a release loaded from a new folder showed the defaults. Reproduced in Chromium: verification/v192-drift-settings-vault-browser.json scenario negativeControlBaseline (1.9.1).

design.driftSettings: lib/safety-policy-vault.mjs: two independent sections (policy GFK1, drift GFD1) in the same folder, each with its own committed copy, stage and save time; the drift record is {values, keySavedAtMs}, one save time per setting, and two copies met through Chrome Sync are combined setting by setting. lib/operator-settings.mjs: saveOperatorSettings stamps only the settings in an operator patch (driftSettingsSavedAtMs; injected stamps are stripped); saveOperatorSettings stamps only settings whose value changes, never behind the known time (+1); mergeDriftSettings lets the newest save of each setting win (tie -> vault; never-saved defaults never seed; values without a time count as DRIFT_STAMP_DEFAULT=1 for a carried default and DRIFT_STAMP_LEGACY=2 for a pre-1.9.2 non-default value); reconcileLocalDriftSettings computes the merge inside withOperatorSettingsLock, which uses Web Locks (navigator.locks, shared by the side panel and the service worker, verified in Chromium 141); every whole-record writer re-reads inside that lock (saved-mission writes replace only savedMissions; backup restore writes under it). background.js: every Drift save goes through saveDriftSettings (setMaxActiveSessions, saveQueueSettingsFromPanel with only the sent fields, EIC_GF_SET_POST_DELAY from the side panel; the panel sends only changed queue fields), reconciled before and after the save by a serialized two-way reconcileDriftSettings; the same reconciliation runs at startup (once per browser session, before the scheduler reads maxActiveSessions) and after a backup import. The queue awaits each run's real end (the 8 s limit bounds only the caller's answer). Backup restore keeps the later of installation and backup per setting. A vault failure never blocks startup or the local save. Save times are a logical clock (a save outranks every time seen for the setting; vault times are never clamped on read, only absurd ones above year 3000 are refused). Review 2026-10-07 (sonnet reviewers, adversarial sonnet verifiers): the first design (one save time for the group, panel-side writes) lost data and was replaced; round 2 found seven defects; a final check found that a moving read-time clamp could revert a save; all fixed with regression tests.

environment.kind: local Node harness with real background.js and mocked Chrome APIs (in-memory chrome.bookmarks = one Chrome profile); Chromium via Playwright with the real installed extension and a real profile bookmark store (drift: unmodified extension, settings set through the panel's own controls); panel regression tools with the real panel and a stubbed background

baseline.command: npm test (v1.9.1, git archive of commit 3e2f9e6, re-run for this release)

reproductionBeforeChange.command: tests/v192-drift-settings-vault.test.mjs against the v1.9.1 tree (1.9.2 lib/safety-policy-vault.mjs and lib/operator-settings.mjs copied in, not wired); tools/verify-drift-settings-vault.mjs with GF_BASELINE_ROOT=v1.9.1
reproductionBeforeChange.result: tests 10/26 (pure module tests pass; every background integration test fails: 1.9.1 has no drift vault and none of its entry points); Chromium: 1.9.1 folder B shows the defaults

claimBoundary.liveChrome: Chromium 141 (Playwright build) with the real extension and profile; not the operator's branded Chrome or their profile
claimBoundary.chromeSync: NOT_VERIFIED (bookmark sync between computers; the loader picks the newest committed copy by save time if two meet)
claimBoundary.crossContextLock: Web Locks sharing between side panel and service worker verified in Chromium 141 with a probe extension; in Node tests the per-context storage lock stands in for it
claimBoundary.notVaulted: reservedWorkerId and workModeSupervisorWorkerId (window bindings of one installation), workModeEnabled (on at every start since 1.9.0), workModeEndpoint (not requested), processes, queues and usage history
claimBoundary.packageIntegrity: INTEGRITY.json binds packaged bytes; not a code-correctness proof

knownRemainingRisks: Drift settings saved in 1.9.1 or older in a folder that is no longer loaded are not in the vault; they must be saved once again (or that folder updated in place)
A copy over the same folder needs chrome://extensions 'Läs in igen'; a Chrome restart alone kept the old background (observed again in Chromium 141 for 1.9.1 -> 1.9.2)
A turn already in progress keeps the pause and queue-switch values it took before an adoption; the next turn uses the adopted values
Deleting the bookmark folder 'EIC Greenfield · Run requirements v1' removes the durable copies of both sections; the next save or start re-creates them from the installation's values
